title: ヒシアマ姐さんも勝てない？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, Hishi Amazon visits an amusement park with her fellow dorm residents.

text_block_list.name: Miho Student A
text_block_list.text: Hey, do you wanna try the haunted house next? Rumor is, they've got real ghosts! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Nah, I'll stay here and look after our stuff. You guys go have fun.

text_block_list.name: Miho Student B
text_block_list.text: But, it's no fair to make you keep watch…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Don't feel bad! I was lookin' to take a breather anyway. Go on, knock yourselves out!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Sigh… That was a close one. There's no way I'm admitting that ghosts scare me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I mean, you can't even fight 'em… Ugh, just the thought of them gives me chills!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thinking of her phasmophobia starts to take a toll on Hishi Amazon, and she begins to feel unwell.
